Title: Nikhil and the Family

Cast

1. Nikhil - 10 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Naira - 11 years, daughter
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
3. Meenakshi - 36 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
4. Rohan - 9 years, friend
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Nikhil stands by the road. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Meenakshi: "Let's do something fun today."

[Nikhil rides his bicycle down the road.]

Nikhil: "Really?"

[Nikhil gets into the car.]

Nikhil: "Mom, are you okay?"

[Nikhil gets on the bus.]

Meenakshi: "Hey, look at that!"

[Nikhil gets off the school bus.]

Nikhil: "Mom, are you okay?"

[Nikhil hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Meenakshi (laughing): "Slowly, take it easy."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Nikhil stands in the courtyard. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Meenakshi: "What a nice place."

[Nikhil bursts out laughing.]

Nikhil: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Nikhil folds his hands and prays.]

Meenakshi: "Nikhil, are you okay?"

[Nikhil lights a bonfire.]

Nikhil: "Yes, all right."

Scene 3: The courtyard - Night

Meenakshi: "So, here we are!"

[A full moon shines in the sky.]

Meenakshi: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Fireflies glow in the dark.]

Nikhil: "How beautiful!"

Scene 4: The park - Day

[Nikhil stands in the park. Naira and Meenakshi stand near him.]

Naira: "Let's begin."

[Nikhil goes jogging in the park.]

Nikhil (gently): "Oh wow!"

[Nikhil kicks the football hard.]

Meenakshi (excited): "Naira, listen!"

[Nikhil swings on the swing.]

Meenakshi: "I'm ready!"

[Nikhil does push-ups.]

Meenakshi: "And then?"

[Nikhil does yoga on a mat.]

Naira (happily): "Show me too!"

[Naira skips rope.]

Meenakshi: "What a day to remember!"
